claim_ceiling: A one-step Petz recovery baseline for a finite-dimensional four-qubit random-unitary channel. It is not a macroscopic black-hole decoder, efficient quantum circuit, gravitational evaporation model, or QES/island calculation.

channel.scrambler: U(4) applied to M tensor B
channel.inaccessible_environment: B_prime, dimension 2; traced out as the channel environment and never passed to the decoder

decoder.name: Petz recovery for maximally mixed qubit reference state
decoder.support_policy: No eigenvalue flooring, PSD projection, or trace-preserving completion. The full-rank small-instance channel is checked directly; support loss/nonconvergence is a typed failure.
decoder.inverse_square_root: Unregularized 4x4 complex Hermitian Newton-Schulz iteration; residual ||W rho_A W-I||_F is reported.
decoder.cost_boundary: Dense classical linear-algebra work is reported separately from physical quantum gate count. No fault-tolerant decoder circuit synthesis is claimed.

analytic_control.expected_interpretation: The outgoing E wire is the original M wire and R is a spectator; Petz recovery discards R and forwards E.

independent_numpy_comparator.generator: NumPy default_rng(0x4850); sequential independent complex-Gaussian QR/Gram-Schmidt Haar U(4) draws; direct channel-Kraus construction and eigendecomposition inverse square root
independent_numpy_comparator.seed_schedule: single frozen NumPy Generator stream; one Haar U(4) draw per sample
independent_numpy_comparator.note: Independent NumPy eigendecomposition and PRNG path; not bitwise expected output for the Rust ChaCha20 implementation.

proposed_acceptance.ensemble_seed_reproducibility: exact deterministic equality for identical first seed and sample count

rust_contract.ensemble: Independent ChaCha20 seeds; per-seed Petz fidelity, Welford mean/standard error, minimum/maximum fidelity and maximum inverse-square-root/trace-preservation residuals.

next_baselines: exact optimal recovery via small-instance SDP/channel optimization
held-out scrambler seeds and decoder calibration
noise sensitivity, message-size scaling and accessible-radiation fraction sweep
negative_controls: supply B_prime to the decoder at runtime
use the full four-qubit state vector as decoder input
floor small rho_A eigenvalues and conceal the regularization
silently repair a non-trace-preserving recovery map
report classical Petz arithmetic as physical quantum gate count
call one-step Petz recovery an efficient macroscopic black-hole decoder
